name: fb-vscode-language
description: FreeBASIC 1.20.5 highlighting, type-aware IntelliSense, navigation, reference help, and compiler diagnostics for Visual Studio Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Editing and indexing remain available. Compiler diagnostics and compiler analysis are disabled.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Language services remain available. Compiler diagnostics and local include links require files on disk.

scripts.test: npm run build:grammar && npm run audit:grammar && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:unit && npm run test:grammar

freebasic.inlayHints.parameterNames.enab.description: Show compiler-selected parameter-name hints for procedures, constructors and macros. Type and control-flow hints remain available when disabled.

freebasic.analysis.compilerPath.description: Optional editor-bridge fbc for full native symbols, macro/source origins, scopes, unsaved-buffer analysis, Outline/workspace symbols, and validated project refactoring. Build or rebuild it with npm run build:compiler-bridge. Stock schema-27 sidecars also provide saved-file physical navigation, macro Signature Help, selected macro-signature hovers, and macro parameter inlays, requesting full macro data only for recognized macro interactions. Compiler-backed analysis requires FBC 1.20.4 or newer; older compilers retain syntax highlighting, source-based editor features, and ordinary compiler checks.

enumDescriptions: Only run compiler analysis from the FreeBASIC: Analyze Module With Compiler command.
Run compiler analysis on the first editor request for a source snapshot, then reuse it until inputs change.
Run compiler analysis after a saved module changes.
Run compiler analysis after edits with a 400 ms debounce; unsaved buffers require the editor bridge.
freebasic.analysis.run.description: Compiler analysis supplies saved-file expression types from a schema-27 fbc on demand by default. Stock sidecars also provide saved-file physical symbol/macro navigation, compiler-selected macro Signature Help and parameter inlays, and selected macro-signature hovers, requesting the full macro graph only at recognized macro interactions. The protocol-14 editor bridge adds complete macro origins, unsaved-buffer analysis, Outline/workspace symbols, and validated project refactoring. FBC 1.20.4 or newer is required; older compilers keep syntax highlighting and source-based editor features while compiler-backed analysis is disabled. Sidecar-only analysis refuses dirty inputs rather than using stale disk contents. Requires a trusted workspace.

freebasic.analysis.timeoutMs.description: Time limit in milliseconds for a native semantic-analysis request. Large macro-heavy modules may need more time than ordinary diagnostics.

freebasic.analysis.projectContexts.description: Explicit complete build contexts for compiler-backed project navigation, Find References, and project rename. Each context lists a unique name, .bas module paths relative to the workspace, and additional compiler arguments. Stock FBC semantic sidecars support saved-file navigation and references, including macro references only when all selected uses map to physical source tokens; project rename and unsaved-buffer validation require the editor bridge. Omitted configurations are not validated.

freebasic.analysis.activeContext.description: Selected build name and translation unit from analysis.projectContexts. Headers are analyzed through this module; .bas files use their own root in the same named build. Null uses base compiler options for modules and disables native header analysis. Use FreeBASIC: Select Compiler Context to choose.

freebasic.compiler.path.description: Path or command name for the FreeBASIC compiler used by diagnostics and, when supported, saved-file semantic analysis. The default uses fbc on PATH on Linux and macOS. On Windows it first checks C:\freebasic\fbc64.exe, C:\freebasic\fbc32.exe, then C:\freebasic\fbc.exe before falling back to PATH. An explicit compiler path overrides discovery. Schema-27 compiler analysis requires FBC 1.20.4 or newer.

freebasic.compiler.arguments.description: Additional arguments passed to fbc before the extension's compile-only arguments.

enumDescriptions: Only run compiler diagnostics with the FreeBASIC: Check Current Module command.
Run compile-only diagnostics whenever a saved .bas module changes.

freebasic.diagnostics.maxErrors.description: Maximum errors requested from fbc for one compiler check.

freebasic.diagnostics.timeoutMs.description: Time limit in milliseconds for one compiler check.

freebasic.includePaths.description: Additional directories for include navigation, indexing, and compiler checks (-i). ${workspaceFolder} is supported.

freebasic.index.exclude.description: Glob used to exclude files from the FreeBASIC workspace index.

freebasic.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of .bas and .bi files loaded into the workspace index.

freebasic.index.maxSymbolResults.description: Maximum results returned by workspace symbol search.

freebasic.index.workspaceConcurrency.description: Concurrent compiler workers for workspace symbol indexing. Reduce to 1 for lower peak memory and smaller observed timer gaps on large workspaces; cold indexing takes longer.

freebasic.index.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum size in KiB for background-indexed files. Open documents are still analyzed. Rename is disabled while the index is incomplete.

freebasic.index.maxCompletionResults.description: Maximum indexed workspace declarations added to one completion request.
